security_findings.finding: planError is rendered as a plain JSX text child, not via dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
security_findings.note: React escapes it to literal text; not exploitable as XSS. Flagged as a maintainability guardrail for future refactors, not an active vuln.

security_findings.finding: No length/format cap on planError string.
security_findings.note: A very long backend error message could visually break layout on narrow viewports; not a security issue, needs CSS overflow handling if wired to a real backend later — out of scope.

approved_points: Diff matches ATDD/code_diff claims: planError defaults to null, onRetry optional, no crash if omitted.
Priority rule planError && !isGeneratingPlan correctly implemented — no case where both indicators show simultaneously.
PlanCard rendering is structurally untouched by this diff — driven solely by messages/staleMessageIds/editingPlanMessageId, so 'approval never silently reopens due to an error' holds by construction.
Retry button only calls onRetry?.() and does not self-clear planError — matches AC-3 (no auto-dismiss).
role="alert" correctly distinct from the polite aria-live loading/message-list regions.
Textarea/send button correctly left enabled during error state (AC-5).
82/82 tests passing including 5 new tests for this task.
overall_assessment: Clean, narrowly-scoped, presentational addition consistent with #264-266's parent-controlled prop pattern. No XSS risk (React escaping). 'Approval never opens on error' invariant holds by construction since PlanCard's render path is independent of the new props.
